settings.title: The vision behind Stud Von Axe

settings.editor: Over the years, we have carefully developed a select group of exceptional mares from some of the world's most distinguished dam lines. Every breeding decision reflects our passion for show jumping and our commitment to producing horses of the highest quality.

By combining proven, high performing mares with carefully chosen stallions, we strive to produce modern sport horses with the talent, athleticism and pedigree required to succeed at the highest levels of international competition.

settings.custom_css: selector img { aspect-ratio: 3/2; object-fit: cover; width: 100%; border-radius: 18px; }

settings.editor: Some are bred here. Others are carefully sourced and developed. What they share is the quality, potential and attention that define every horse we choose to represent.

settings.custom_css: selector img { aspect-ratio: 3/2; object-fit: cover; width: 100%; border-radius: 18px; }

settings.editor: Strong maternal lines are at the heart of our breeding programme. Each mare brings proven genetics, performance and the potential to produce the horses we want to see in the sport of tomorrow.

settings.custom_css: selector img { aspect-ratio: 3/2; object-fit: cover; width: 100%; border-radius: 18px; }

settings.editor: Born from proven bloodlines and raised with care, our foals are selected and developed with one goal: to become the sport horses of tomorrow.

settings.custom_css: selector img { aspect-ratio: 3/2; object-fit: cover; width: 100%; border-radius: 18px; }

settings.editor: Selected from outstanding families and proven sport horse combinations, our embryos give breeders and owners access to bloodlines with real breeding and performance potential.

settings.custom_css: selector img { aspect-ratio: 3/2; object-fit: cover; width: 100%; border-radius: 18px; }

settings.editor: We offer ICSI semen from selected stallions, stored at Avantea and available at competitive prices, making proven genetics more accessible to breeders.

settings.title: We also look on your behalf.

settings.editor: Our work extends beyond the horses we breed ourselves. We source and broker carefully selected sport horses and breeding mares for clients who value quality, transparency and expertise. Every search begins with understanding what the client needs, and ends with finding the right opportunity.

settings.custom_css: selector img { aspect-ratio: 4/3; object-fit: cover; width: 100%; border-radius: 26px; }

settings.title: Tell us the horse you have in mind.

settings.editor: A dose for your own mare, a cross already made, or a foal on the ground. Say what you are after and we will tell you plainly what we have.
Results, stories and moments from the stud. Follow the horses we breed, develop and represent, from the sport arena to the breeding programme.
Write to us and we will get back to you.
